Provides exploration funding, but the raise is small in absolute terms; proceeds are earmarked mainly for Langis exploration and drilling.
The placement adds shares and may dilute existing holders; the release gives no pre-placement share count.
The options create potential future dilution; vesting is immediate except for investor relations personnel, whose options vest over 12 months.

This is a financing update for an exploration-stage company, rather than a report of new exploration results. Progress at Langis and further financing or drilling updates would be needed to create a larger catalyst.
